name: forward_library_calls_and_return
description: Loads a library base from a global and calls five indirect library routines at fixed negative offsets from it. It stores the result of the first call in a global, records its own address in another global, and returns a value saved earlier.

name: forward_library_calls_and_return
description: Loads a library base from a global and calls five indirect library routines at fixed negative offsets from it. It stores the result of the first call in a global, records its own address in another global, and returns a value saved earlier.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:6:03B4
name: open_trackdisk_and_run_io
description: Opens trackdisk.device with a message port set up through a task lookup, then issues disk I/O requests with DoIO. It closes the device and removes the port again before returning.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:6:040C
name: verify_disk_volume_entry
description: Saves its argument, queries a library twice for values, and compares a 12-byte table entry against two saved values and a short. It returns zero when they all match and minus one otherwise; the text darkseed_1: and df0: suggests it checks disk volume names.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:6:092C
name: compute_masked_byte_sum
description: Adds the low and high bytes of a global word and keeps six bits of the sum. The facts show it also touches the VHPOSR video beam position register, so the input is probably a raster position.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:6:0940
name: skip_terminated_records
description: Calls a unnamed routine to get a count, then walks a global byte block and skips that many records, each ended by a minus-one byte. It returns nothing.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:0000
name: find_table_entry_by_byte
description: Scans up to fifteen pointer entries and returns zero when the byte at offset 55 of an entry matches the argument. It returns the argument if an empty entry ends the scan, minus one if nothing matches, and minus two if the argument is not positive.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:0040
name: scan_entry_table_for_byte
description: Scans up to fifteen pointer entries for one whose byte at offset 55 matches the argument, and returns no value. It stops at an empty entry or immediately if the argument is not positive.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:0072
name: compact_and_sort_pointer_table
description: Packs the non-empty pointers of a fixed table to the front, then reorders the list so entries with a larger byte at offset 6 come first. It scans from the table start to a fixed end address.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:009C
name: sort_pointer_list_by_priority
description: Reorders a null-terminated pointer list in place so entries with a larger byte at offset 6 come first, using an exchange-based sort. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:00CE
name: allocate_buffer_with_header
description: Allocates a memory block with the Amiga memory allocator and fills its header with the byte argument, a fixed word of 1000, and size and flag fields taken from the caller's registers. When a flag bit is set it builds a chain of two or three sub-blocks with row offsets, and it returns minus three if the allocation fails.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:0242
name: add_indexed_plane_buffer
description: Allocates a block sized to the requested length rounded up to a 16-unit boundary, and stores it in the next free slot of a table of fifty pointers. Depending on flag bits it either copies a 20-word header and raster rows into a second buffer with a mask OR, or updates the entry's row count; it returns minus one when the table is full and minus three when allocation fails.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:0314
name: blit_pointer_table_rows
description: Takes ownership of the blitter, sets its first and last word masks and modulo registers from a mask built from the argument, then starts one blit for each pointer in a table until a null entry. It waits for the blitter to finish and releases it again.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:03AC
name: call_with_temporarily_swapped_fields
description: Saves a pointer field and a flag byte of a record, replaces them with the argument and the value one, and calls a unnamed routine with a fixed mode value. It then restores the original field values.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:04BC
name: build_index_table_from_markers
description: Walks a table of three-byte records until a minus-one terminator, storing the running record index into a buffer for each record whose first byte is minus two. It counts those matches in a global byte and clears one byte after the buffer.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:04FC
name: draw_tile_grid_with_blitter
description: Reads tile codes from a byte stream, where two special codes stand for fill and skip, and blits each tile to a grid position derived from its index. It runs until a loop counter reaches zero, then releases the blitter.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:0620
name: refresh_sprite_list_for_dma
description: Clears the active flags for fourteen slots, then walks a linked list of object records and, for each active one, stores its computed screen position and calls unnamed routines. The evidence shows it writes the DMA control register with bit 15 set, which enables DMA channels, and it clears a global counter when done.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:0838
name: stub_unmatched_render_entry
description: The entry has only five instructions and is referenced only by a pc-relative address, so its own behaviour is not recoverable here. The decompiled body listed for it is a mask-row renderer that belongs to a larger routine, so the name only marks an unrecoverable entry.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:084C
name: stub_unmatched_render_entry
description: The entry has only five instructions and is referenced only by a pc-relative address, so its own behaviour is not recoverable here. The decompiled body listed for it is a mask-row renderer that belongs to a larger routine, so the name only marks an unrecoverable entry.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:0860
name: render_masked_plane_rows
description: Clears nine table words, counts sprite columns whose accumulated offsets pass a threshold of 999 to set mask bits, and packs the bit tests into destination words row by row. The evidence also lists writes to the DMA control register, which enable DMA channels.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:0A36
name: decode_rows_via_lookup_table
description: Reads bytes backwards from a source buffer, maps each through a lookup table at a base pointer, and writes them into destination rows whose width and count come from registers. It advances to the next row by a stride, then sets a global control word and calls two unnamed routines at the end.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:0CDA
name: fill_rows_blitter_d_channel
description: Takes the blitter and runs a destination-only blit for each entry of a pointer list, setting the size register from the second argument. It repeats until a termination flag is set and then releases the blitter.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:0D2C
name: blit_clipped_bitplane_rows
description: Clips the starting column and row of a rectangle against fixed screen bounds, then blits each row of bitplane data with first and last word masks, choosing one of two destination buffers. It takes and releases the blitter around the loop.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:0E44
name: blit_shifted_bitplane_rectangle
description: Blits a bitplane rectangle with a horizontal bit shift taken from the low four bits of the argument, using first and last word masks derived from that shift. It steps the source and destination pointers row by row and releases the blitter afterwards.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:0F16
name: stub_empty_sign_check
description: The decompiled body only tests a register for a negative value and returns in either case, so it has no visible effect. Its listed 16 instructions are not reflected in the body, so its role cannot be recovered from the evidence.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:0F3C
name: setup_blit_and_copy_rows
description: Sets up a register block with first and last word masks, a modulo and a control value, then loops over source rows and calls a unnamed routine to copy each packed row. It calls three library routines around the setup.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:0FA4
name: prepare_blit_registers_row_copy
description: Sets the first and last word masks and a control value in a register block, with the modulo set to zero and the offset taken from a source word. It then loops over row entries and calls a unnamed routine to copy each row; three library routines run around the setup.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:100E
name: wait_for_flag_then_call
description: Repeatedly calls a unnamed routine while a global word stays nonzero, then makes one final call to the same unnamed routine. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:102E
name: call_pair_if_zero_result
description: Calls a unnamed routine that returns a value and, when that value is zero, makes two further unnamed routine calls. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:1050
name: update_record_table_entries
description: Clears a result word, then walks a table of record pointers and copies two coordinates from the input into each active record before calling a unnamed routine. It then calls unnamed routines for each entry of a second table of up to fifty entries and makes a final library call.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:10E2
name: advance_sprite_animation_frames
description: For each of fifteen active records, counts down a delay and steps an index between two limits, either wrapping or bouncing according to flag bits. It then looks up the frame and its delay in an animation table, applies position offsets for flagged animations, and calls unnamed routines for certain frame numbers of certain record types.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:118E
name: deactivate_record_after_countdown
description: Clears the active bit of a record when its flag bit is set and its countdown byte has reached zero. It also clears the record's table pointer unless the record's type byte is a specific value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:12F4
name: initialise_animation_record
description: Fills a record's animation fields from its arguments: a frame table pointer, index and limit bytes, flag bits, and a pair of words. When the animation flag is set it takes the frame from the scaled index in the table, otherwise it clamps the index to the limit, and it returns minus one when the unnamed routine check fails.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:1378
name: step_scan_rows_by_mode
description: Selects a loop pattern from a global mode byte and repeatedly calls a unnamed routine while stepping a coordinate by fixed increments of 240 within bounds. The branches depend on mode codes, and the purpose of the loops is not recoverable from the body alone.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:13F8
name: step_until_bound_by_240
description: Repeatedly calls a unnamed routine while decrementing an argument by a step of 240 until it falls to a fixed bound. The evidence says the entry was reached only by decoding a gap, so it may be data rather than a real routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:14A8
name: blit_four_row_strip_positions
description: Sets up a blitter-style register block with a control value and fixed size fields, then loops four times calling a unnamed routine with positions offset from a base pair. If a flag argument is nonzero the routine spins in an endless loop, otherwise it finishes with a library call.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:1500
name: blit_four_row_strip_offsets
description: Sets a register block with masks and a control value, then loops four times calling a unnamed routine with positions offset from two base arrays, using a fixed size field. If a flag argument is nonzero it spins in an endless loop, otherwise it finishes with a library call.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:3:1568
name: toggle_mode_around_call
description: Sets a mode byte to 16, calls a unnamed routine, then sets the mode byte to 64. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0000
name: scale_and_clamp_into_record
description: Starts from a global value and scales it by a word field and then a byte field of the record, applying each scale only when the field is below 128 and shifting right by seven bits after each multiply. It clamps the result to a maximum of 64 and stores it in a byte field of the record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0038
name: select_record_from_slot_pairs
description: Checks a record at a base index and its partner at the index with the low bits flipped, then the same pair one step later, for one whose flag 8 is clear and whose byte at offset 48 does not exceed the argument. It stores a flag bit from the chosen index and returns that record's address, or zero if none qualifies.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:011C
name: store_byte_masked_with_two
description: Masks the byte passed in a register with the value two and stores the result through a pointer. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:012A
name: stub_empty_return
description: The decompiled body is a bare return and the 22 listed instructions do not appear in it, so the routine's effect cannot be recovered from the evidence. It is reached only through a data pointer.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0166
name: advance_fixed_point_list_position
description: Computes a fixed-point position from record fields and a table value, using a fixed-point multiply unnamed routine when a flag bit is set. It walks a linked list, adding 65536 to a segment count and subtracting 65536 from the position each time the position is above a bound, then calls a unnamed routine to store a clamped result when it passes a second threshold.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0208
name: update_word_when_delta_exceeds
description: Compares the argument minus a longword field of the record against a fixed threshold, and when the difference is larger it calls a unnamed routine and stores its word result in a record field. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0228
name: call_routine_if_nonzero
description: Calls a unnamed routine only when the 16-bit argument passed in a register is nonzero. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0258
name: stub_empty_return
description: The body is a bare return with two listed instructions, so there is no behaviour to recover. It is referenced only through a data pointer.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:025C
name: advance_segment_state_machine
description: Adds the argument to a position field of a record, then steps a state byte through cases that load the next segment pointer and its timing values, calling unnamed routines when a segment changes. It returns immediately when the record pointer is null.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0288
name: load_next_segment_state
description: Handles the state transitions for states one, three and six, loading the next segment pointer and its timing fields and calling unnamed routines. The five listed instructions are fewer than the body shown, so this may be a shared fragment.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:029A
name: load_segment_and_check_timing
description: Loads the next segment for states six or three, sets its timing fields and calls a unnamed routine, then checks whether a running value has passed the segment duration. The check decides whether the state machine continues.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:02DC
name: enter_state_four_with_timing
description: Sets the state byte to four and copies a timing word from the input record, clearing a flag once the position passes a threshold. It stores a single-bit mask derived from a byte field, with the timing values, into a global record and calls a unnamed routine to finish.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:02F0
name: step_segment_level_envelope
description: Loads the next segment when the state byte is three, then, unless the state is four, either accumulates a clamped 16-bit level from a running value or decrements a segment counter and reloads the level from the segment data.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:030E
name: start_level_ramp_segment
description: Sets the state byte to two and loads a timing field and a starting level from the input, then runs the clamped accumulation step while the state is not four. It decrements the segment counter and moves to state one or four when it reaches zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0374
name: finish_segment_and_latch_state
description: Sets the state byte to four and copies the input timing into the record, then updates a flag byte from a longword field before calling a unnamed routine. It latches a single-bit mask from a byte field into a global control record, with a default duration of 1000 when none is set.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0380
name: start_segment_from_input_record
description: Points the record at a sub-record of the input, loads its level and calls unnamed routines, then finishes the segment through the shared latch step. It latches the same global control record as the other segment routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:03AA
name: clamp_level_and_finish_segment
description: Adds a running value to a level field, clamps the sum to the range zero to 32768, and subtracts the elapsed value before finishing the segment through the shared latch step. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:03C4
name: zero_level_and_finish_segment
description: Zeroes a level field, subtracts the elapsed value from a timing field, and finishes the segment through the shared latch step. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:03FC
name: latch_control_record_mask
description: Optionally sets a flag bit on the record, then latches a single-bit mask from a byte field into a global control record, using a duration of 1000 when none is set, and calls a unnamed routine. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:043E
name: store_words_then_call_table
description: Stores the value 1000 and a zero word into two fields of the record, then calls a routine through a table entry. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0454
name: clear_flag_bits_across_slots
description: Calls a unnamed routine four times, then clears the top bit of a flag byte in each of sixteen records spaced twenty bytes apart and in a global flag byte. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0492
name: write_audio_channel_constant
description: Sets a single-bit mask in a record from a byte field and sets a flag byte, then calls a unnamed routine. When a level field is below 37 it writes a longword constant to the audio channel registers selected by the channel number.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:04D6
name: reset_record_and_release_channel
description: Decrements the active-count global unless the record type is sixteen, clears the record's fields, and calls a unnamed routine. It writes a constant to the audio channel registers when a level field is below 37.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:050A
name: init_struct_and_toggle_flag
description: Sets a record's word fields to 500, 8192 and zero, and its two byte fields to 24 and 128. It then sets or clears bit 0 of a flag byte from an input bit, clears bits 2 and 4, and sets bit 7.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0550
name: apply_voice_effect_command
description: Reads a command byte and its parameter from a script and applies it to a voice record. Codes set a 7-bit level word, combine low bits into it, set a volume capped at 24 with a derived period, set a sub-volume, or toggle flags, and the remaining codes are handled by unnamed routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0568
name: apply_voice_volume_command
description: Handles four command codes for a voice record: it updates a 7-bit level word from a parameter, sets a volume capped at 24 with a derived period, and sets or clears a flag bit. Unrecognised codes are left for other handlers.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0582
name: apply_voice_flag_command
description: Handles the flag-related command codes for a voice record, setting or clearing bit 0 or bit 3 from the parameter. For the 64 code it clears bit 2 in a table of up to four voice records that share the same owner.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:05C6
name: release_matching_voice_records
description: Handles command codes that set a count, toggle a flag and scan a table of four voice records. It clears a flag bit in every record that matches the current voice and sets its state to three.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:05DC
name: apply_voice_control_command
description: Handles the command codes for setting bit 0 from a parameter, setting bit 3, and clearing bit 2 across matching records. It falls through to other handlers for unmatched codes.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0600
name: set_record_flag_bit_one
description: Sets bit 0 of a flag byte in the record and returns. The entry is a two-instruction unnamed routine, so this is its whole behaviour.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:060A
name: apply_voice_status_command
description: Applies a command byte to a voice record: the '@' and 'A' codes set or clear status bits, and '@' also resets matching records in a table of four entries. The 'Q' and other codes pass control to unnamed routines, and 'd' stores the parameter into a byte field.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0622
name: clear_flag_reset_owned_records
description: Clears bit 3 of a flag byte in a voice record, then scans a table of four records and, for each one owned by this record, clears bit 2 and sets its state to three when that bit was set. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:064E
name: apply_voice_parameter_command
description: Dispatches a command byte to a voice record: 'A' sets or clears bit 2 and a counter, 'd' and 'e' store the parameter into two byte fields, and the tilde and code 127 codes set or clear bit 1. The remaining codes call unnamed routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0666
name: clear_flag_and_set_marker
description: Clears bit 2 of a flag byte in the record and sets a neighbouring byte to 255. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0676
name: apply_voice_parameter_subset
description: Dispatches a subset of command codes to a voice record, storing the parameter in two byte fields and setting or clearing bit 1 for two of the codes. The other codes call unnamed routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:068C
name: forward_to_routine_call
description: Makes a single call to a unnamed routine and returns, with no other effect visible in the body. The listed two calls are not both shown, so the body is a thin forwarder.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0698
name: dispatch_voice_parameter_commands
description: Stores the parameter into one byte field for the 'd' command and into another for the 'e' command. Tilde and code 127 set or clear bit 1 of a flag byte and call unnamed routines, and the remaining codes call unnamed routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:06A6
name: dispatch_voice_commands_with_e
description: Stores the parameter into a byte field for the 'e' command. The other codes it handles set or clear bit 1 for tilde and code 127 and call unnamed routines for the rest.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:06B4
name: dispatch_voice_bit1_commands
description: Sets or clears bit 1 of a flag byte for the tilde and code 127 commands, and calls unnamed routines for the remaining codes it recognises. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:06C0
name: dispatch_voice_bit1_brace_commands
description: Calls a unnamed routine for the brace command and sets or clears bit 1 of a flag byte for the tilde and code 127 commands. The 'x' command calls a unnamed routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:06CC
name: set_clear_voice_bit1_commands
description: Sets bit 1 of a flag byte for the tilde command and clears it for code 127, then calls a unnamed routine. Other codes are not handled here.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:06DE
name: clear_voice_bit1_or_forward
description: Clears bit 1 of a flag byte for code 127 and calls a unnamed routine; the 'x' command calls a unnamed routine too. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:06F0
name: call_routine_on_x_command
description: Calls a unnamed routine only when the command byte passed in a register is the letter x. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:06FC
name: assemble_value_and_scale_diff
description: Builds a 16-bit value from a parameter byte pair and stores it in a record field. It then stores a scaled difference from 8192 in another field, scaled by a byte field, and sets the top bit of a flag byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0728
name: multiply_with_sign_fixup
description: Calls an unsigned unnamed routine on the two operands and negates the result when exactly one operand is negative. It returns the signed product.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:074E
name: pass_through_routine_result
description: Calls a unnamed routine and returns the second register value it leaves behind, with no other work. The entry was reached only by decoding a gap, so it may not be a real routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0758
name: forward_to_routine_call
description: Makes a single call to a unnamed routine and returns with no other effect. Three unnamed routines call this entry.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0760
name: perform_32bit_division
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor and returns the quotient and remainder together. A bit-by-bit shift-and-subtract loop handles divisors above 16 bits, and a 16-bit divide handles smaller ones.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:07D4
name: interpolate_table_then_shift
description: Looks up two adjacent entries of a 16-bit table using the high byte of the argument, interpolates between them by its low byte, and shifts the result by an exponent taken from the upper word. It returns zero when that exponent is 32 or more.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0A26
name: initialise_audio_driver_state
description: Allocates a driver block, sets pointers to its voice and table sections, and sets two initial mode bytes. It installs an interrupt server when the driver is not yet initialised and returns one if the allocation fails.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0B66
name: release_audio_driver_resources
description: Stops the driver's unnamed routines, removes the interrupt server, and frees the driver block when each was set up. It returns the result of the block release, or zero when no block exists.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0BCE
name: open_audio_init_voices
description: Initialises sixteen voice records and their tables, copying data with a memory copy call, then opens audio.device and replies to its message port. The work is guarded by a global flag so it runs only once.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0D48
name: close_audio_clear_voices
description: Clears the running flag, clears the status flags of four voice records and calls a unnamed routine for each one that has its flag set. It then closes the audio device and marks the driver as closed.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0DB6
name: start_voice_for_record
description: Assigns a voice to a record when its input byte is nonzero and it has a sample pointer, using a table of four voices or a unnamed routine. It then sets the record's flag bits and stores its start position.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0E50
name: start_voice_with_volume
description: Assigns a voice record from a table and copies the sample pointer, length and a flag byte into it, setting its state to six. Its volume comes from a global flag bit or a default of 128, scaled by a byte field of the input.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0E7C
name: start_voice_from_message
description: Initialises a voice record from its input pointers and volume, sets its state to six and a default duration of 1000, then takes a message from a port and replies to it. The volume rule matches the neighbouring start routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:0F50
name: service_voice_message_port
description: Handles pending audio device messages, advancing a voice record's counter and a global count. It switches the record's channel when two flag bits are set and the stored value is valid, and replies to each message it takes.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:1046
name: clear_voice_record_fields
description: Zeroes a voice record's first longword, its two flag bytes, its counter byte and a further longword field. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:105A
name: match_voice_key_and_latch
description: When a record is active and is the current voice in a table of four, compares the input byte with a table byte chosen by a flag bit. On a match it sets the record state to three, or latches a flag bit when flag 8 is set.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:1094
name: match_record_key_and_latch
description: Compares the input byte with a key byte stored in a record and, when they are equal, sets the record's state to three or latches bit 2 of a flag byte depending on flag 8.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:10AA
name: latch_flag_bit_two
description: Sets bit 2 of a flag byte in the record it is given. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:10B4
name: match_table_record_and_latch
description: When a record's marker byte is nonzero, looks for the record in a table of four entries. On a match it sets the entry's state to three, or latches flag bit 2 when the record's flag 8 is set.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:10D6
name: reset_matching_table_states
description: Walks a table from a starting index for a count passed in a register. For each entry equal to the record it sets the state to three, or latches bit 2 of a flag byte when flag 8 is set.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:10E6
name: call_routine_for_table_matches
description: When the record's marker byte is nonzero, calls a unnamed routine for each table entry that matches the record. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:1112
name: reset_table_and_channel_records
description: Calls a unnamed routine for each non-empty entry of a table of four, then for each of sixteen records calls a unnamed routine, clears bit 1 of a flag byte and sets a byte to 255.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:1158
name: store_table_entry_pointer
description: Stores into a pointer the address of a table entry chosen by the low six bits of an input byte, with a stride of twenty-two bytes. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:1174
name: store_argument_and_routine_result
description: Stores its word argument into a global and stores the result of a unnamed routine call into another global. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:11C4
name: set_flag_from_routine_result
description: Calls a unnamed routine and sets bit 1 of a global flag byte when its returned word is zero, clearing the bit otherwise. The evidence lists the CIA port A register, which holds the fire button and disk status, so the unnamed routine probably reads that input.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:11E0
name: check_global_flag_bit
description: Returns one when bit 1 of a global flag byte is clear and zero when it is set. It returns no value otherwise.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:11F4
name: update_voice_table_and_timers
description: Applies pending flag bits to the four voice records, adds a running timer value, and walks the table updating each active voice's state and counters.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:12A4
name: advance_voice_table_timers
description: Decrements a timing counter for each entry in a table of voices and applies the change to each active voice's position and state. It calls unnamed routines for the audio hardware and touches the VHPOSR beam position register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:1370
name: process_voice_control_codes
description: Processes a voice's control byte: the minus-128 code sets the voice's position and resets its counters, and the minus-one code updates flag bits and calls unnamed routines. Other codes step through the sequence data.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:1396
name: run_voice_sequence_script
description: Steps through a voice's sequence script, resetting its level and timing fields from the script bytes and advancing a timing accumulator by a word field. It continues until a command byte ends the run.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:13C0
name: advance_voice_script_timer
description: Handles the end-of-script code by either clearing a flag bit or restarting the script from its saved pointer. It then advances a timer word and calls unnamed routines for each table entry.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:13E0
name: finish_script_step_and_update
description: Clears bit 0 of a flag byte, saves the script pointer and advances a timer. When the timer passes its target it calls unnamed routines three times, otherwise once, then sets bit 2 and updates table entries that have a flag set.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:13EA
name: dispatch_voice_script_commands
description: Dispatches script command bytes for a voice: three codes call unnamed routines, and the minus-96 code either writes a script byte into a voice field and calls a unnamed routine, or selects a mode from another script byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:1424
name: dispatch_script_commands_subset
description: Dispatches a subset of script command bytes for a voice, calling unnamed routines for two codes. The minus-96 code writes a script byte into a voice field or steps a mode counter.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:1452
name: dispatch_script_mode_commands
description: Handles two script command codes: the minus-64 code calls a unnamed routine, and the minus-96 code writes a script byte into a voice field or advances a mode counter stored in the voice record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:147A
name: dispatch_script_call_and_signal
description: Handles the minus-96 script command: sub-code one writes a byte to a voice field and calls a unnamed routine, and sub-code two pushes a return pointer onto a small stack. The routine signals a task through the exec library when the voice is set up.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:14B0
name: push_and_pop_script_return
description: Handles script commands two and three: command two pushes the current script position onto a stack of up to four entries, and command three pops the most recent entry when its count is nonzero. It resumes from the popped position.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:14E0
name: resume_script_from_stack
description: Pops the most recent script return entry when its count is nonzero, decrements the count and resumes the script from the stored position. It updates the timing fields before continuing.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:1514
name: run_script_until_wait
description: Stores a state value in a voice field and runs the script loop, reading command bytes and advancing a timing accumulator until the loop reaches a wait condition.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:151C
name: read_script_commands_until_negative
description: Reads script bytes in a loop, advancing a timing accumulator, clearing a flag bit and calling a unnamed routine for each non-negative byte. It stops when a byte is negative.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:1522
name: store_script_position_and_latch
description: Saves the script position, advances the timing accumulator and calls unnamed routines depending on whether the timing passed its target. It then sets bit 2 of a flag byte and updates table entries whose flags are set.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:154E
name: latch_flags_into_voice_record
description: Calls four unnamed routines, sets bit 2 of a flag byte, and clears it when any table entry is in use. It then copies the masked flag bits into a record byte and returns zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:158A
name: clear_flag_bit_active_entries
description: Walks a table of entries, calling a unnamed routine for each one with bit 3 set and clearing bit 2 for each active entry. It then copies the masked flag bits into a record byte and returns zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:15BC
name: advance_table_loop_counter
description: Decrements a counter and repeatedly advances through a global table, skipping entries whose first byte is minus 96 with a zero flag. It reloads the traversal pointer from another global entry until the counter runs out.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:1638
name: reset_sequence_state_if_idle
description: Calls a unnamed routine, and when it returns zero clears several flag bits, resets the traversal pointer and the state counters, sets bit 0 of a flag byte and returns one. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:16DC
name: set_bit_four_if_nonzero
description: Calls a unnamed routine and sets bit 4 of a global flag byte when the zero flag is clear, which means the unnamed routine's result was nonzero. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:16EC
name: clear_flag_and_release_table
description: Clears bit 0 of a global flag byte and calls a unnamed routine for each non-empty entry of a table of four. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:8:1720
name: set_global_flag_bit_zero
